name: Venture
description: The original Reload map, a shrunken-down version of the classic Chapter 1 island centered on Tilted Towers.

name: Oasis
description: A desert-themed island inspired by the Chapter 1 biome, with Paradise Palms as its central POI.

name: Slurp Rush
description: A Chapter 2-inspired island centered on Slurpy Swamp, packed with Slurp-themed locations.

name: Squid Grounds
description: A Squid Game collaboration map featuring The Labyrinth, Red Greens, and Square Meals.

name: Nitemare Island
description: A Halloween-themed Fortnitemares 2025 map with Spooky Suburbs, Haunted Hamlet, and Terror Turrets.

name: Surf City
description: A Chapter 7-inspired Hollywood and West Coast map with Battlewood Boulevard at its center.

name: Elite Stronghold
description: The personal fortress of the Elites, featuring Elite Armory, Chiseled Cubes, Hostile Hold, and more.
